current.text: He could be a bench microwave scorer for Minnesota and is an outside option for the open starting spot.
Four Minnesota starters are set: LaMelo Ball, Anthony Edwards, Jaden McDaniels and Rudy Gobert. The fifth starting spot is open.
Jonathan Kuminga is expected to take a starting spot, and Josh Green might start too.
Minnesota may need to trade Josh Green to afford the Kuminga signing.
Minnesota's bench is thin and has little scoring punch.
Donte DiVincenzo will miss most of the season and Mike Conley is gone, so there are fewer guards ahead of him.
Minnesota plays only two games in the week starting March 15, which is week 20 of our fantasy playoffs.
He is ranked well outside the 144 players drafted in our league. He is not a draft target, but he is worth watching on waivers if he wins a role.

Early in the season, check whether he wins the open fifth starting spot or the bench scorer role over Kuminga and Josh Green before you spend FAB on him, and keep in mind Minnesota's two-game week in playoff week 20.
